description: 4 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars tune the GitHub Copilot assistant itself: copilot-instructions.md, its PR-review behaviour, answer verbosity. Near-misses share the Copilot or review vocabulary and route elsewhere: the dev environment Copilot runs inside (devcontainer), a code review of a diff (code-review-lens), and CI workflow YAML on GitHub (github-ci). Counterexamples guard the 'instructions' and 'suggestion' vocabulary in unrelated work.

queries.q: rewrite our .github/copilot-instructions.md so Copilot stops suggesting deprecated helpers
Copilot's PR review comments are too noisy — make it flag only correctness issues
tune GitHub Copilot to give shorter answers in chat for this repo
passe die Copilot-Instruktionen an, damit Copilot unsere Namenskonventionen beachtet
set up a devcontainer.json so Codespaces has PHP 8.3 and the Copilot extension preinstalled
queries.note: the environment Copilot runs inside, not Copilot's behaviour → devcontainer

queries.q: review this pull request for bugs before I merge it
queries.note: a review of the diff itself, not configuring Copilot's review → code-review-lens

queries.q: add a GitHub Actions job that runs the linter on every pull request
queries.note: GitHub vocabulary, but the ask is workflow YAML → github-ci

queries.q: write installation instructions for the CLI in the README
add a search box with autocomplete suggestions to the product page
